channel.title: Sample Football Desk
channel.description: Offline sample feed bundled with Touchline Takes. Fictional stories for testing only.

item.title: Arsenal beat Chelsea 2-1 in a tense London derby at the Emirates
item.description: Arsenal came from behind to beat Chelsea 2-1 at the Emirates on Saturday. Tomas Reyes equalised before half-time and Leo Hartmann headed the winner in the 78th minute, lifting Arsenal to second in the Premier League table.

item.title: Celtic extend Scottish Premiership lead with 3-1 win over Rangers
item.description: Celtic beat Rangers 3-1 at Celtic Park to move five points clear at the top of the Scottish Premiership. Winger Ross Callan scored twice in a dominant second-half display.

item.title: Bayern Munich come from behind to win 3-2 at Bayer Leverkusen
item.description: Bayern Munich scored twice in the final ten minutes to win 3-2 at Bayer Leverkusen in the Bundesliga. Substitute Jonas Weber struck the winner in stoppage time to send Bayern top.

item.title: Manchester United preview: Ruben Castell wants response against Fulham
item.description: Manchester United manager Ruben Castell wants a response when his side host Fulham this weekend. United have lost two of their last three Premier League games and are 11th in the table.

item.title: Inter Milan agree contract extension with defender Paolo Ricci
item.description: Inter Milan have agreed a contract extension with centre-back Paolo Ricci until 2030. The 27-year-old Italy international has made 140 Serie A appearances for the club.

item.title: Grassroots clubs welcome new pitch funding
item.description: Local clubs across the country have welcomed new funding for artificial pitches. Organisers said the money would help more children play the game through the winter.
